profile.headline: Software Engineer at Click Therapeutics, Inc.
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and oversaw the release of the human capital Workday mobile app worldwide, allowing employees to perform Human capital self-service items from their devices in a secure & safe environment through our mobile VPN. 
- Developed and automated data integrations between our human capital system and a new vendor, to seamlessly recruit, hire and on-board new employees, saving countless hours of data-entry and repetitive manual labor. 
- Created the trader’s data feed to satisfy the MIFID2 directives and provide prompt and accurate data to regulators. 
- Designed, tested and implemented, absence, leave & time off plans in Workday; created, maintained and supported payroll, benefits and compensation integrations in studio, Java and XSLT; automated profile picture uploading  
- Designed, developed, implemented and tested a quality control framework in SQL to catch, analyze, and report missing, corrupt, and stale data in order to minimize financial model errors while working in the Multi-Assets Team. The QC system puts the data through a customizable adapter to standardize the data, performs a series of analyses on it and finally sends it out as a report.
- Optimized Matlab code to speed up financial model performance by 73%.
- Created a front-end application to expose real-time and historical data used by account managers as a standalone module in our Research Analyst Portal, to analyze, distribute and performing business analytics. The project was developed using C# and using the .net framework and WCF services to connect to the backend.
- Working on porting and enhancing an Outlook extension application in C# to the Web using MVC and JS that is used by portfolio managers in the Equities and Multi-Assets Teams to manage their products.

positions.title: Co-founder/CTO/Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Created a socially conscious hyper-local delivery platform, to connect buyers, sellers and couriers, offering deli items and alcoholic beverage bundles with a standardized price, developed in SwiftUI and backend in python. 
- Developed an algorithm to find the shortest convoy-style route between different stores and customers, minimizing the number of stops to get all items while also minimizing wait time for all customers. 
- Worked full-stack; integrated Apple pay with Stripe, developed REST APIs in python, MYSQL & redis database.

positions.title: Co-founder/CTO/Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Co-founded and developed a location-based app to meet your people and
make friends through common interests and personality matching
- Worked on the full-stack, ranging from database design and implementation to
the full development of the iOS app
- Created features such as the personality matching algorithm, an
activity-type recommendation system to match users with each other, a full chat system, and group matching recommendations based on locations and members' availabilities

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Working in the Fixed Income data analytics team to develop and design the front and backend of a new exceptions reporting module in C# and SQL for the Research Analyst Portal that identifies portfolios and securities with wrong data.
- Improved overall workplace efficiency by reducing the time portfolio managers' time spent examining
spreadsheets by roughly 50%.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Did research in the field of haptography; like photography in the visual domain haptography enables individuals to record haptic feel of a real object to reproduce it later for others to interact.
- Ported and implemented code in C++ to create a toolkit that enhances 3D virtual environments rendered using an impedance-type haptic interface by adding texture feeling via high frequency vibration.

positions.title: Intern - Web Developer
positions.description: - Developed and programmed in Javascript with the D3 library an intuitive graphical design to stream timed data to a front-end user interface.

positions.title: Website Administrator
positions.description:
- Helped in the production of the Sociology Department's website in Drupal.
- Maintained and updated the website weekly on a part-time basis.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Manager
positions.description:
- Responsible for the design and maintenance of various websites, including front-end and back-end development.
- Met with prospective and old clients and guided them through the development process and implementation of their websites.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Out for Undergrad is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to helping high-achieving lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender (LGBT) undergraduates reach their full potential in their careers. We are a network of volunteers from the professions we seek to serve.
- Organized and managed all aspects of the O4U Tech conference agenda attracting over 200
high-achieving LGBT students from all over the country.
- Organized panels, tech talks, keynote speakers, and gave an industry overview.
- Organized an off-site Hackathon for over 200 students and was one of the judges for the competition.
• Worked as a translator for surgeons and doctors at missions in Paraguay.
